title: Gold Leaf Mix Duo 2-Color #08 (가로 띠·매끈 / 대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-colour gold-leaf body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 2 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 2 horizontal bands by 1 hazy transition zone centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright EMERALD GREEN sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is everything below the first transition zone: it carries applied 24K YELLOW GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright 24K YELLOW GOLD sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
